subject: server: add hooks to wait for background commit goroutines (#55608)
summary: Adds a per-session commit wait group (exposed via `sessionctx.Context`) and plumbs client-go transaction lifecycle hooks through a new kv option/store driver so shutdown draining can wait for async commit/secondary-lock-cleanup goroutines. No Blocker/High issues found in the kv/session/sessionctx/store changes in this commit.
